name: ElevenLabs
billing: Speech synthesis consumes your plan’s character or credit allowance. Check the selected voice/model price, remaining quota and per-key credit limit. The local example synthesizes only “Hello.”

steps.title: Create or sign in to your account
steps.body: In ElevenLabs, open Developers and select the API Keys tab.

steps.title: Create a restricted API key
steps.body: Name a separate application key, allow the speech synthesis endpoints it needs and choose an appropriate credit limit. Keep useful restrictions enabled.

steps.title: Choose a model and voice
steps.body: Select a speech synthesis model and voice that your account can use. Set their identifiers on your own machine as PRISM_SETUP_MODEL and PRISM_SETUP_VOICE; the example does not create or clone a voice.
